title: Art and gallery visits
intro: Choose a guide around the kind of looking you want to do: comparing works, reading labels, interpreting a space or using a museum’s digital material.

title: Science, nature and family observation
intro: Use these planning guides to separate your own questions and proposed timetable from current admission, activity and access arrangements. Confirm arrangements with the operator before travelling.

title: Historic places, objects and writing
intro: Explore Pittsburgh-area and regional places through objects, interpretation and research questions. The guides distinguish published evidence from the fictional exercises used to practise planning.

title: Preparing for a performance
intro: Read a programme, identify the work and credits, and prepare listening or viewing questions. A guide is preparation for checking a current event, not a reservation or an event-calendar listing.

title: Bicycles, transport and design
intro: Keep a transport plan separate from a museum visit: one guide works through station and return questions, while the other uses bicycle objects to explore design and history.
